name: Hotjar
description: Hotjar has been merged into Contentsquare. New Hotjar accounts are no longer available; heatmaps, session replay, surveys, funnels, and related experience-analytics capabilities are now sold and delivered through Contentsquare.
best_for: Best suited to existing Hotjar users planning the transition and to teams evaluating behavior analytics, session replay, heatmaps, funnels, surveys, and experience insights in the current Contentsquare product suite.
features: Sense AI features and LLM/MCP connectivity on current Contentsquare plans

alternatives.name: Heap
alternatives.description: A product analytics platform that automatically captures every user interaction without manual event tagging.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams wanting automatic data capture for conversion and retention analysis.

alternatives.name: Matomo
alternatives.description: Privacy-first analytics with full data ownership via self-hosted or cloud deployment.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting privacy-compliant analytics without vendor lock-in.

pricing.starting_price: Contentsquare Experience Analytics: Free $0; Growth starts at $49/month billed annually

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Experience Analytics Free includes up to 200,000 monthly sessions, 1 project, replays, heatmaps, funnels, error/performance monitoring, and basic surveys.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Experience Analytics starts at $49/month billed annually; starts from 7,000 monthly sessions and includes 3 projects and longer data access.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Quote-based for Experience Analytics; aimed at higher-volume and revenue-focused analysis.

cons: New users cannot create a Hotjar account; they are directed to Contentsquare instead.
The old Hotjar plan names and prices are no longer the right basis for a new purchase decision.
Contentsquare pricing is product-specific: Experience Analytics Growth starts at $49/month billed annually, while other products such as Voice of Customer have separate plan pricing.

faq.question: Can I still sign up for Hotjar?
faq.answer: No. Contentsquare states that new users can no longer create a Hotjar account. New signups are directed to Contentsquare, where Hotjar's heatmaps, session replay, surveys, and related capabilities now live.

faq.question: What happened to Hotjar?
faq.answer: Hotjar merged into the Contentsquare Group and its core experience-analytics capabilities are now part of the Contentsquare product suite.

faq.question: How much does the current Hotjar replacement cost?
faq.answer: Contentsquare Experience Analytics has a Free plan at $0. Growth starts at $49 per month when billed annually. Pro and Enterprise are quote-based. Contentsquare also sells other products, such as Voice of Customer, with separate pricing.

faq.question: What should existing Hotjar customers check before switching plans?
faq.answer: Review your current session limits, projects, retention, surveys, integrations, user access, and billing. Compare those requirements against the current Contentsquare Experience Analytics and Voice of Customer plans rather than relying on old Hotjar plan names.
